req.title: Reject limit above cap
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the 'limit' parameter exceeds the maximum allowed value. This behavior needs to be validated through a series of tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_limit_within_cap
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in-process.
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with limit=1000.
expected: The response contains a list of tasks.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/?limit=1000')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert isinstance(response.json(), list)
